summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce FDA accelerated approval of GENGLYCOS (DTX401) for glycogen storage disease type Ia. The approval was supported by the Phase 3 GlucoGene study. Post-marketing commitments include a Disease Monitoring Program with 50 treated and 20 control patients over 10 years. This is a regulatory milestone, not a special-situation transaction. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic review is present. The filing is routine disclosure of a product approval, so no special-situation category applies.
